output.reason: The evidence contains two statements: (1) “In the event of foreclosure or pre-payment of the loan, in full or in part… pre-payment charge of 2% of the principal outstanding,” and (2) a separate statement and table row stating a “pre-payment charge of 3% of the principal outstanding” payable on “pre-payment or foreclosure.” This directly supports that the agreements conflict on whether the charge is 2% or 3% for foreclosure or pre-payment.
